data.name: Private Old Hollywood Trolley Tour
data.headline: Sightseeing Trolley Tour of Hollywood and Beverly Hills (Seats up to 18)
data.description:
##Duration
3 Hours

##About
Join us on our Hollywood Sightseeing Tour. We will travel through the city on a vintage Trolley Bus, experiencing the sights, sounds and charm of Los Angeles in a unique and nostalgic way. Our Trolley Bus is a restored piece of history, with its classic design, tufted seats and brass details, it will transport you back in time as we take you on a journey through the city’s most iconic neighborhoods and landmarks.					

##More Info
With our Luxury Los Angeles Bus Tour, you will travel in style through the entertainment capital among the theaters and stars of Hollywood Boulevard. Wind through charming Hollywood Hills, one of the historic neighborhoods of celebrity life. Have an exquisite look at some of the elite highlights of luxurious Beverly Hills. Experience legendary Sunset Strip – the place of rock music history. With stops at LA cultural centers like The Original Farmers Market and the beautiful museums along Miracle Mile, you’ll create memories of a lifetime.

Hollywood Boulevard
- “Feel the excitement of the most iconic cultural district in the city of Los Angeles.”
- Hollywood Walk of Fame
- Capitol Records
- Hollywood Sign
- Musso & Frank
- Hollywood Wax Museum
- El Capitan\
- Dolby Theater
- TCL Chinese Theatres
- Hollywood Museum

Hollywood Hills
- “Move through the winding hills and beautiful homes in the heart of Hollywood.”

Sunset Boulevard / West Hollywood
- "Journey along this lively thoroughfare of bustling culture and glamorous nightlife.”
- Sunset Plaza
- Sunset Tower Hotel
- Sunset Strip
- Comedy Store
- Whisky a Go Go
- The Viper Room
- The Roxy Theatre

Beverly Hills
- “Experience the luxury style of celebrity living and the exquisite beauty that surrounds this famous city.”
- 15 min stop
- Beverly Hills Hotel
- Beverly Hills sign
- Rodeo Drive
- City Hall/Civic Center

Miracle Mile/Museum Row
- “Enjoy the amazing architecture and history along vibrant Wilshire Boulevard.”
- 15 min stop for Photo at Urban Lights
- LA County Museum of Art 
- Petersen Auto Museum
- Academy Museum of Motion Pictures
- La Brea Tar Pits

The Original Farmers Market
- “Grab a treat and take in the exotic foods, sights and sounds of over 100 gourmet vendors at this beloved historic open market.”
- Passenger can choose to be dropped off here

##What's Included
- Air-conditioned vehicle
- Driver/Guide
